commentary.text: 90+10' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+10' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
90+8' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the right post.
90+7' The referee blows his whistle as Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) was too aggressive in his challenge.
90+6' Edgar Gonzalez (Almeria) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90+5' 2 - 2 Goal! Sergio Arribas is the provider and Marko Milovanovic (Almeria) is the executioner, dispatching the cross into the right of the goal from close in with his head. 2:2.
90+4' Some patient build-up play from Sevilla as they look to unlock the defence.
90+1' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for a foul.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.

86' 1 - 2 Goal! Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the left post. He makes it 1:2.

84' It's time for a substitution. Sergio Arribas (Almeria) comes on in place of Jonathan Viera.

38' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Adrian Embarba (Almeria). Jonathan Viera plays a fantastic through ball and finds Adrian Embarba (Almeria), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
37' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
36' Dion Lopy (Almeria) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Orjan Nyland easily deals with the threat.

35' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Isaac Romero (Sevilla) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Luis Maximiano pulls off a brilliant save.
34' Dion Lopy (Almeria) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
33' A loose ball is pounced on by Isaac Romero (Sevilla) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Luis Maximiano is alert and makes a comfortable save.
32' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Luis Maximiano pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
32' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Almeria for a penalty. Play continues.
32' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Choco Lozano (Almeria) who sends his header well wide of the right post.
31' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) runs onto a rebound and unleashes a piledriver from distance that flashes a whisker wide of the right post.
30' A quickly taken corner by Sevilla.

28' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) creates some space for himself near the penalty spot and aims a decent header towards the top of the net, but Luis Maximiano reacts brilliantly and diverts the ball onto the crossbar.
28' The resulting corner from Oliver Torres (Sevilla) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
27' Boubakary Soumare (Sevilla) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
24' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) finds some space to control the ball from the corner and shoots, but his attempt goes way wide of the right post.
24' Luka Romero (Almeria) makes a strong challenge and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows for a foul.
23' Oliver Torres (Sevilla) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
22' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
21' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
19' Choco Lozano (Almeria) commits a rough foul. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea stops the game and makes a call.
17' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) unleashes a shot, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies well wide of the left post.
14' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
13' Kike Salas (Sevilla) manages a fine header towards goal, but it misses the target as the ball flies past the left post.
9' Luka Romero (Almeria) is first to react to a great cross from Jonathan Viera, but slices his shot high over the bar from inside the box.
7' Sevilla hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
5' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

3' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.

3' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the left post is, however, superbly saved by Orjan Nyland!
